title: Case study: heart failure exacerbation
text:
Emergency department, 1400. A 72-year-old client with heart failure (ejection fraction 30%), hypertension and type 2 diabetes comes in with 4 days of worsening shortness of breath. The client says, "I have to sleep sitting up in my recliner now." The client ran out of furosemide 1 week ago and ate ham and canned soup at a family gathering over the weekend.

Home medications: furosemide 40 mg PO daily, lisinopril 10 mg PO daily, metoprolol succinate 50 mg PO daily, metformin 500 mg PO twice daily.

| Assessment | Finding |
|---|---|
| BP | 158/94 mm Hg |
| Heart rate | 108/min, regular |
| Respirations | 28/min |
| SpO2 | 89% on room air |
| Temperature | 98.4 F |
| Weight | 84.5 kg (clinic weight 2 weeks ago: 81.0 kg) |
| Neck veins | Distended with head of bed at 45 degrees |
| Ankles | 3+ pitting edema on both sides |

title: Case study: urinary sepsis in an older adult
text:
Medical unit, 0700. An 81-year-old client from an assisted living facility was admitted overnight with a urinary tract infection. History: type 2 diabetes, hypertension, mild cognitive impairment. Weight 58 kg. Baseline per her daughter: oriented to person and place, follows a conversation, forgets recent events, walks with a walker.

Home medications: metformin 1,000 mg PO twice daily, lisinopril 20 mg PO daily, amlodipine 5 mg PO daily. No known allergies.

| 0700 assessment | Finding |
|---|---|
| BP | 88/50 mm Hg (home average 142/80) |
| Heart rate | 112/min |
| Respirations | 24/min |
| Temperature | 101.8 F |
| SpO2 | 94% on room air |
| Urine | 60 mL of dark, cloudy urine since 2300 |

The daughter says, "She's not herself. Yesterday she was chatting with me on the phone."

title: Case study: diabetic ketoacidosis
text:
Emergency department, 2200. A 19-year-old college student with type 1 diabetes comes in with 2 days of vomiting and abdominal pain. The roommate says the client stopped taking insulin glargine 2 days ago "because I wasn't eating." The client is drowsy but answers questions.

| Assessment | Finding |
|---|---|
| BP | 98/58 mm Hg |
| Heart rate | 124/min |
| Respirations | 32/min, deep |
| Temperature | 99.1 F |
| Weight | 62 kg |
| Bedside glucose | 486 mg/dL |
